Published list totals 61, not 60 (the Effects heading says 10 but nine are listed); kept as published. The strategy's update says one Visage Of The Emperor was swapped for a second Tatooine Occupation and Evader & Monnok for Broken Concentration; the list is kept as posted.
Watto is posted x3 although the card is unique; kept as published.
